SkillAlchemy v0.1.1

Added a large collection of self-distilled, ready-to-use Skills under the /skills directory.
Updated and introduced initial references, usage examples, and documentation for new Agents and domains.

SkillAlchemy v0.1.0

- Initial release of SkillAlchemy: a coordinator skill for distillation and fusion tasks.
- Orchestrates two sub-skills: Lens (problem analysis) and LEAP (execution).
- Structured multi-phase workflow with depth selection, interactive checkpoints, and "run with defaults" mode.
- Provides dependency checks and guides users to install required sub-skills (Lens and LEAP).
- All user interaction and routing handled by SkillAlchemy; sub-skills do not interact with users directly.
- Ensures outputs are organized and intermediate files are cleaned up post-execution.
